title: Radiant Lift in Ocala, FL | Everesse + CoolPeel | GLO
meta: Radiant Lift in Ocala, FL pairs Everesse RF tightening with a CoolPeel CO2 laser in one visit to lift, firm and refresh skin. From $1,050. Book a consult.
answer: Radiant Lift is GLO's combination treatment: Everesse radiofrequency tightens and lifts from deep in the skin, then a CoolPeel CO2 laser refreshes the surface, all in one visit. It suits loosening skin plus dull tone, fine lines or texture on the face and neck, upper arms or abdomen. Visits take 70–120 minutes, with 24–72 hours of redness.
treats_intro: Radiant Lift treats loosening skin and surface concerns together: a softening jawline and neck, crepey upper arms or abdomen, plus dullness, fine lines, sun damage and rough texture.
how: Radiant Lift combines two technologies in one visit. First, Everesse delivers monopolar radiofrequency (RF) energy with continuous cooling to heat the deeper layers of your skin, tightening existing collagen and prompting new collagen to form. Then a CoolPeel treatment on the Tetra Pro CO2 laser resurfaces the very top layer to improve tone, fine lines and texture with far less downtime than traditional CO2. One works from within, the other on the surface.
fit_h2: Is Radiant Lift right for me?
good_fit: You have mild-to-moderate loosening on your face, jawline, neck, upper arms or abdomen
You'd also like smoother texture, softer fine lines or a brighter, more even tone
You'd like the benefits of two treatments in a single visit
You can plan for 1–3 days of redness while your skin heals
not_fit: You have a pacemaker or another implanted electronic device
You're pregnant or breastfeeding, or have significant metal implants in the treatment area
You have an active cold sore, skin infection or open wound in the treatment area, or you've recently taken isotretinoin (Accutane)
You only want tightening with no downtime — Everesse skin tightening on its own may be the better fit
expect_h2: What happens during a Radiant Lift appointment?
expect_intro: A Radiant Lift visit takes 70–120 minutes, depending on the area. Everesse comes first, with continuous cooling to keep you comfortable. Then we apply numbing cream before the quick CoolPeel laser passes. Expect redness, like a mild sunburn, for 24–72 hours.

faq_rename.Is there any downtime?: Is there any downtime after Radiant Lift?

faq_add.a: Everesse feels like deep warmth, with continuous cooling to keep you comfortable. We apply numbing cream before the CoolPeel, and most people feel only warmth and a light prickling. Your skin may feel warm for a few hours afterward.

faq_add.q: How many Radiant Lift sessions do I need?
faq_add.a: It depends on your skin and goals. Your provider will recommend a plan at your consultation. Collagen from the Everesse portion keeps building for about 6 months.

faq_add.q: How long do Radiant Lift results last?
faq_add.a: You'll see some tightening right away and smoother, brighter skin once the redness fades. Collagen keeps building for about 6 months. How long results last depends on your age, skin and lifestyle, since your skin keeps aging. Results vary.
